text:
incident-bot: Pager: Sev2 alert - embedder tail latency spike affecting ~12% of requests in us-west-2, auto-escalated to oncall. https://monitoring.redwood/alerts/EMB-Tail-171888
ava_oncall: seeing 4xx error rate + p99 jump, routing fallback triggered. investigating KV eviction logs now.
luke_sre: I'm on it, pulling logs from the 21:03 window. ETA 15m.
maya_pm: Heads-up for customer comms: a subset of high-QPS customers saw timeouts. I'll draft a note once we know blast radius.
tom_infra: re-routing looks healthy but capacity dropped on a couple dedicated pools, suspecting node OOM churn. Collecting node-level metrics.
priya_eng: adding traces for a recent deploy - can we confirm deploy revision?
luke_sre: deploys show a small change to cache reclaim flags at 20:58, will correlate.
ava_oncall: mitigation -> scaled up fallback pool, reduced impact to ~2% errors, still want a post-incident review. :thumbsup:
maya_pm: schedule postmortem this week please, want action items prioritized into Q2 roadmap.
kevin_research: can we quantify token-level cost regression from the fallback? need numbers for tradeoff discussion.
priya_eng: quick note: reproduction steps in dev: `curl -H 'x-model: embed-v2' "https://staging.redwood/embed?text=..."` produces similar latency when kvcache TTL set low.
luke_sre: ok after 45m: root cause looks like aggressive KV cache eviction policy combined with a recent GC flag. Drafting blaze notes.
ava_oncall: creating post-incident thread and starter action items now.
ava_oncall: ACTIONS (initial, untriaged):
- A1: Revert aggressive cache reclaim flag in runtime config + test (owner: priya_eng, estimate: 1d)
- A2: Add node-level OOM alert + runbook (owner: tom_infra, estimate: 2d)
- A3: Measure fallback cost delta and per-customer impact (owner: kevin_research, estimate: 3d)
- A4: Postmortem writeup and customer comm draft (owner: maya_pm, estimate: 1d)
- A5: Add canary for cache changes in staging with synthetic KV-heavy load (owner: luke_sre, estimate: 2d)

maya_pm: prioritization suggestion: A4 (comm) = P0, A1 (revert) = P0, A2 = P1, A5 = P1, A3 = P2. Tie A1/A5 to Q2 reliability sprint.
priya_eng: agree with P0 for revert, will open PR today. Estimate actually ~6-8hrs for PR+canary smoke. Adjust A1 estimate to 8h.
tom_infra: OOM alert runbook draft attached in the ticket, will need infra review. estimate stands at 2d for full QA.
kevin_research: will provide a cost/delta spreadsheet and per-tenant impact matrix by EOD+2 (3 days).
luke_sre: I'll own the postmortem skeleton, aiming to present at Wed retro. Need owners to confirm estimates so we can size sprint tickets.
maya_pm: goal: decide on which items to lift into next sprint (highest severity and easy wins). Proposed: A4 and A1 in next sprint, A2 & A5 in the following. A3 stays backlog unless cost is >10%.
ava_oncall: bump: please ACK estimates in thread so I can create Jira tickets and link to incident report.
priya_eng: ACK A1 8h, will include a canary toggle.
luke_sre: ACK A5 2d, I'll coordinate with priya for canary plan.
tom_infra: ACK A2 2d.
kevin_research: ACK A3 3d.
maya_pm: ACK A4 1d.
ava_oncall: created tickets: RJ-4821 (A1), RJ-4822 (A2), RJ-4823 (A3), RJ-4824 (A4), RJ-4825 (A5). Linking to postmortem doc: https://docs.redwood/postmortems/EMB-Tail-171888
luke_sre: quick tech note for the postmortem: include KV hit-rate histogram vs seq len, and the GC schedule for impacted nodes.
priya_eng: will push revert PR + smoke tests in the morning, pinging for review.
maya_pm: scheduling postmortem sync Thu 10:00 PT. Please add agenda items: timeline, RCA, action item owner confirmation, customer comm.
ava_oncall: thanks team — closing live mitigation thread, moving to post-incident tracking. :white_check_mark:
